main_text.p: liæ rege esse, & concilii sedem primæ-vam ad Thermopylas in Thessalià fuis-se: deinde iftinc in Phocidem, ubi po-fteris temporibus fuit, esse tranflatam. Accedit verisimilitudo sententiæ eidem quoque ex populis, quos primum con-cilii hujus participes fecisse Amphictyo-nem Pausanias docet numero x, quo-rum plurimos aut Thessalos fuisse, aut Thessaliæ proximos, eidemque posteris sæculis etiam accensos esse constat; ni-mirum Dolopes, Ænianes, Magnetes, Phthiotas, Maleenses, ipsos Thessalos,[illegible, ~8 letters] Perrhæbos, [illegible, ~6 letters] adhuc tenuisse tempore suo, Æschines in [illegible, ~6 letters] [illegible, ~12 letters] oftendit, licet pro Dolopibus Perrhæbos, pro [illegible, ~5 letters] ianibus Aetæos videatur nominatos. Usitatum autem est, proximos quos-que populos in hujusmodi concilia loco ipsis commodo & vicino primum coire. Præter hos verò in societate hac Amphictyonicâ jam inde ab initio fuère Phocenses, Bœoti, Locri Iones, inter [illegible, ~4 letters] etiam Athenienses censebantur. [illegible, ~5 letters] rum quando, & à quo sedes in Phocidem tranflata fit, affirmare prom-ptum non est: quanquam ad Acrisium [illegible, ~5 letters] tempore præpotentem in [illegible, ~4 letters] id referre forsan non fuerit ab-um. Quinimò turbat nos heic idem

page.notes: Top line: page number "192" is clipped and partly doubtful. The running head at the top is smudged and mostly unreadable. Left margin carries several small fragments and reference marks, mostly illegible; placed approximately. The Greek words in the line beginning "ratione" are not legible enough to transcribe and are marked illegible. The word "societate" and the phrase "quos-que" are conjectural from a damaged edge. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. No signature visible at the foot, only a faint mark, so left out. The final line is cut at the page edge, and the last words are incomplete.
